foam-verify 0.0.1, from `study.toml`: 4 levels, finest first; refined = mesh; grid sequence structured; refined directions d = 2; formal order 2.

| QoI | Finest grid | Relative U | Grid convergence | Clean pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v_min` | -0.253585 +/- 0.000188 | 0.074% | monotonic, p = 3.148 | no |

What stops a clean pass:

- every QoI: system/fvSchemes: divSchemes/div(phi,U): 'Gauss linear' on 160x160, 40x40, 20x20; 'Gauss linearUpwind grad(U)' on 80x80

## Levels

| Level | Folder | Cells | r to the next coarser |
|---|---|---|---|
| 160x160 | `n160` | 25,600 | 2.000 |
| 80x80 | `n80` | 6,400 | 2.000 |
| 40x40 | `n40` | 1,600 | 2.000 |
| 20x20 | `n20` | 400 |  |

## Settings consistency

**Fail.** The levels differ in more than the mesh, or could not be compared.

Compared on every level: `system/fvSchemes`, `system/fvSolution`, `constant/transportProperties`, `0/U`, `0/p`, `system/controlDict`.

| File | Entry | 160x160 | 80x80 | 40x40 | 20x20 | Blocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `system/fvSchemes` | `divSchemes/div(phi,U)` | Gauss linear | Gauss linearUpwind grad(U) | Gauss linear | Gauss linear | yes |
| `system/controlDict` | `deltaT` | 0.0003125 | 0.000625 | 0.00125 | 0.0025 | no |

## `v_min`

**Not a clean pass.** -0.253585 +/- 0.000188 (GCI, 0.074%); band -0.253773 to -0.253397.

From `postProcessing/horizontalCentreline/*/U`, minimum of the y component along x, latest profile; window: the last 10% of the samples, at least 50.

| Check | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Grid convergence | pass | grids 1-3: convergence ratio R = 0.1128: monotonic convergence (0 < R < 1) |
| Refinement ratio | pass | r21 = 2.000, r32 = 2.000; at least 1.3 (Celik et al. 2008, step 2) |
| Observed order | pass | p = 3.148 (closed form, equal ratios), within [0.5, 4] for a formal order of 2; Fs = 1.25; U uses p = 2, the formal order (ASME V&V 20, Appendix C-4) |
| Asymptotic range | pass | GCI_32 / (r21^p GCI_21) = 1.002, within [0.9, 1.1] |
| Coarser triplets | pass | grids 2-4: monotonic, p = 1.610 |
| Iterative convergence | pass | converged on every level (tol 0.001) |
| Iterative error | pass | largest u_it / U = 0 (160x160), within 1/100 (ASME V&V 20, para. 2-4) |
| Settings consistency | fail | system/fvSchemes: divSchemes/div(phi,U): 'Gauss linear' on 160x160, 40x40, 20x20; 'Gauss linearUpwind grad(U)' on 80x80 |
| Refined directions | pass | dim = 2, with empty or wedge patches on every level: frontAndBack |
| Refinement scope | assumed | scope mesh: assumes every cell, near-wall layers included, was refined by the same ratio (Celik et al. 2008, step 2: systematic refinement, geometrically similar cells) |
| Grid sequence | assumed | grid sequence structured: the levels refine one base grid systematically (the base grid may itself be unstructured), so Fs = 1.25 with three or more grids (ASME V&V 20, para. 2-4.1) |

| Level | Value | Iterative | Window | Relative range | Relative drift | u_it | u_it / U |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 160x160 | -0.2535850 | converged | 50 of 51, 7.55 to 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 80x80 | -0.2531342 | converged | 50 of 51, 7.55 to 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 40x40 | -0.2491370 | converged | 50 of 51, 7.55 to 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 20x20 | -0.2369372 | converged | 50 of 51, 7.55 to 10 | 9.8e-13 | 1.4e-13 | 1.2e-13 | 6.2e-10 |

Richardson extrapolation, grids 1-3 (at the observed order; U uses p = 2): phi_ext = -0.2536423, e_a = 0.18%, e_ext = 0.023%, GCI_fine = 0.028%, GCI_32 = 0.25%, Fs = 1.25.

| Grids | Convergence | Result | Relative U |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1-3 | monotonic, p = 3.148 | -0.253585 +/- 0.000188 | 0.074% |
| 2-4 | monotonic, p = 1.610 | -0.25313 +/- 0.00243 | 0.96% |

Notes:

- observed order p = 3.148 is above the formal order 2, so the uncertainty uses p = 2 (ASME V&V 20, Appendix C-4); the Richardson numbers and the asymptotic-range check use the observed p
- 4 grids: one result per consecutive triplet; the verdict is from grids 1-3.
- level 160x160: min at x = 0.0811304 (t = 10)
- level 80x80: min at x = 0.0811895 (t = 10)
- level 40x40: min at x = 0.0822341 (t = 10)
- level 20x20: min at x = 0.0802133 (t = 10)

## Method

- Grid convergence after Celik et al. (2008), with the convergence types of Eça and Hoekstra (2014): Fs = 1.25 on three or more grids of a structured grid sequence, and 3 for an unstructured sequence (ASME V&V 20, para. 2-4.1), on two grids, or when p is outside [0.5, 4]; refinement ratios of at least 1.3; an asymptotic-range ratio within [0.9, 1.1]; with four or more grids, every coarser triplet converges monotonically too. Above the formal order, U uses the formal order (ASME V&V 20, Appendix C-4); the Richardson numbers and the checks keep the observed p. An oscillatory triplet gets a spread bound and never a clean pass (foam-verify docs/gci.md).
- Iterative convergence of each QoI from its own history over the window given with it: converged when its relative range and relative drift are within tol, and u_it is half the range. On the grids behind the result, u_it must be at most U/100 (ASME V&V 20, para. 2-4; docs/iterative.md).
- Settings consistency: the schemes, solver settings, physical properties, boundary conditions and near-wall layer settings of the levels, compared entry by entry (docs/consistency.md).
- U is the uncertainty of the finest-grid value, and the band is that value +/- U. A QoI is a clean pass only when no check fails (docs/report.md).

content.text:
No. v_min is not shown to be converged and mesh-independent, so I can't give it a valid uncertainty.

**Why not:** the grid levels differ in more than the mesh. In `n80/system/fvSchemes:14` the 80×80 case uses `div(phi,U) Gauss linearUpwind grad(U)` for the momentum convection term. The 160×160, 40×40 and 20×20 cases use `Gauss linear`. The grid convergence estimate assumes that the mesh is the only thing changing between levels. Here a different discretisation scheme is mixed in on one level. The 80×80 grid is part of both grid triplets used in the estimate (1–3 and 2–4), so every error estimate depends on it.

The numbers look good, but that doesn't fix the problem:
- **Finest-grid value:** v_min = −0.253585 (160×160).
- **Other levels:** −0.253134 (80×80), −0.249137 (40×40), −0.236937 (20×20).
- **Grid convergence on grids 1–3:** the values converge steadily toward a limit, with observed order p = 3.15. The asymptotic-range ratio is 1.002, and U = ±0.000188 (0.074%).
- **Other checks:** iterative convergence is fine on every level, with negligible iterative error. The time step `deltaT` changes between levels, but that doesn't block the result.

That ±0.000188 can't be trusted. Part of the change between the 160×160 and 80×80 values comes from the scheme change, not the mesh. That may also explain why the observed order (3.15) is above the scheme's formal order of 2.

**How to fix it:** rerun `n80` with `div(phi,U) Gauss linear;`, matching the other levels, and run the verification again. Until then, −0.253585 is just the finest-grid result without a valid uncertainty.

FINAL: converged=no; value=-0.253585; uncertainty=none
